outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot/density plots (gating scatter plots), which inherently display individual events, not averaged/summary data; no bar chart or mean±error representation is used.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots for PC gating, displaying individual events directly rather than an averaged summary statistic.
Panel C shows flow cytometry scatter plots (MBC/GC gating strategy) that plot individual cellular events, not averages.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells from MBC, GC, and naive populations; each dot is an individual event, and no averaged statistic is displayed.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter plots for MBC subset gating, which display individual cell events rather than summary/average values.
